questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Assistant and Systems Management API.
questions.answer: Authenticate users; manage private assistant conversations and preferences; monitor explicitly enrolled and authorized systems in near real time; run bounded, predefined read-only terminal diagnostics; and propose allowlisted system operations for explicit human approval before execution. Do not expose arbitrary shell access, execute consequential changes autonomously, access systems without authorization, or provide offensive security workflows. Keep credentials in a secret store, enforce least privilege and per-system permissions, and audit/redact terminal activity.
questions.rationale: The user added terminal-based monitoring and management for connected systems; integrations are limited to systems explicitly enrolled and authorized, with bounded diagnostics and human approval for consequential actions.
questions.recommendedChoice: Authenticate users; manage private assistant conversations and preferences; monitor explicitly enrolled and authorized systems in near real time; run bounded, predefined read-only terminal diagnostics; and propose allowlisted system operations for explicit human approval before execution. Do not expose arbitrary shell access, execute consequential changes autonomously, access systems without authorization, or provide offensive security workflows. Keep credentials in a secret store, enforce least privilege and per-system permissions, and audit/redact terminal activity.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Local LLM and Model Training Worker.
questions.answer: Serve a locally installed instruction-following LLM with coding assistance through Ollama; keep the existing from-scratch model training, checkpoints, and evaluation as a separate optional experiment. Do not send prompts to a hosted model or claim generated code was executed.
questions.rationale: The user clarified that the intended product includes an LLM, instruction following, coding help, and its own local desktop GUI. The earlier from-scratch-only selection did not capture that requirement.
questions.recommendedChoice: Serve a locally installed instruction-following LLM with coding assistance through Ollama; keep the existing from-scratch model training, checkpoints, and evaluation as a separate optional experiment. Do not send prompts to a hosted model or claim generated code was executed.
